title: Resolution urging US ratification of disability rights treaty
summary: This resolution calls on the US Senate to approve and the President to ratify the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and its Optional Protocol, marking the treaty's 20th anniversary in December 2026. The US signed the Convention in 2009 but has never ratified it, making it the only G7 nation not to do so. The Council notes that nearly one million New Yorkers with disabilities would benefit from stronger accountability and accessibility protections under the treaty.
